identifiability.gauge_fixed.reason: The gauge is fixed a priori and disclosed. The outer function is the one-parameter Box-Cox f_rho(z) = ((1+z)^rho - 1)/rho, so f(0)=0 and f'(0)=1, with rho bounded to [-8, 3]. Inner g_k are monotone with g_k(0)=0, so all flexible shape sits in the inner functions. Inner/outer scale is fixed by sum_k g_k(r_k) = 1 at r_k = 1 after unit-RMS standardization. The residual single-direction outer-vs-inner trade is acknowledged.

These are completeness gaps, not evidence of selective reporting.
